The '''Malsuum system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the planet [[Malsuum]].<ref name="DVatCoS2" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A "Malsum" system appeared in the [[2015]] update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]]. [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', later confirmed that the system name contained a typo and should have been spelled Malsuum,<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_2.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-04-06}}</ref> like in the comic ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows|Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows]]''.<ref name="DVatCoS2" />
